_comment: Discovered-topic registry for the self-building knowledge base. Topics are NOT hand-named; each row corresponds to a tag/entity cluster the brain formed in the live corpus (see discovery pass 2026-06-10). 'realm' drives which Ghost site a page graduates to and is decided by SUBJECT, not by source_id. 'sources' is the realm-scoped read-scope the generator queries (wall-safe). 'treatment' is the design family the brain picks per content shape via the html-anything / hallmark skills - it is a hint, not a hardcode; the generator re-confirms it from the cluster's page mix at build time.
_data_note: VERIFIED 2026-06-10: all tag-bearing synthesis pages currently live in personal-synthesis (519/557 tagged); business-synthesis has 185 pages but 0 tags yet. So KoA-subject clusters are physically sourced from personal-synthesis today. Realm routing is therefore by SUBJECT (tag set), and any KoA page drawn from personal-synthesis must be operator-reviewed before going outward, because it originates in the ACL-walled source. This resolves once business-synthesis carries its own tagged corpus.
